free_tier.stated: 'kuasoso.com网盘资源无偿分享' - free, no account. The landing page lists the newest indexed shares per pan, tagged 夸克网盘 / 迅雷云盘 / 百度网盘.

retention.stated: Index lifetime not published; the '最新入库' list is the only freshness signal.

egress.terms: No traffic of its own; the pan behind each link holds the bytes and its terms apply.

interface_detail: HTTP GET on /doc/<id> per share and a search endpoint; HTML only.
chaining: Same role as 盘行: a source of share links whose value depends entirely on whether the pan behind them can be opened.

identity_cost.detail: No login for reading the index.

reliability_note: The 最新入库 list shows 夸克 and 迅雷 dominating and 百度 present, which is the current share-host mix in one picture.
confidence_note: Landing page read today. No search run.
